title: ULTRON live integration verification

observed_runtime.current_evidence_summary: The local dashboard is reachable and the backend surface appears present, but no fresh authenticated end-to-end verification was performed. The current state is not enough to prove live functional integration or owner-isolated access.

evidence_examined: browser shows connected backend state and heartbeat
provider provenance and stale-state rules in interface/services/providers/websocketProvider.js
known_limitations: No authenticated browser proof of current backend state was obtained
A local socket open does not prove a live, fresh, or authenticated backend response
capability_matrix.exact_blocker: No fresh authenticated current snapshot; system is only locally observed
capability_matrix.recommended_next_action: Complete a private local unlock and authenticated status refresh before claiming live integration

capability_matrix.data_source: local runtime event bus and service registry
evidence_examined: observed runtime IDLE value and four registered agents
runtime event handling and stale-state handling
known_limitations: State is not proven to be fresh or authenticated at the moment observed
No live ownership and authorization gate has passed
capability_matrix.exact_blocker: No fresh authenticated current snapshot and no live operator session
capability_matrix.recommended_next_action: Compare runtime timestamps and provenance after the private unlock is completed

genuinely_works: The local dashboard and gateway are present on localhost and return user-visible runtime state
The UI explicitly distinguishes stale and unavailable states instead of fabricating healthy output
The financial and CRE source contracts refuse fabricated outputs when the required provider, publisher, or analytics data is absent
simulated_or_mocked: CRE publishing is mock-only and not configured
missing: Private local unlock and authenticated dashboard verification
Fresh persisted gallery read and integrity checks
next_three_engineering_actions: Verify manager ownership and source provenance before any live maintenance or helper restart
Complete a private local unlock and authenticated read-only status/gallery verification
Bind the runtime to an approved release bundle and restore rehearsal before any wider deployment decision

prioritized_remediation_plan.objective: Establish authoritative runtime ownership and recovery authority
prerequisites: Read-only source and runtime inspection of the manager, state directory, and current process identities
Operator identification of the original manager owner or equivalent startup record
prioritized_remediation_plan.scope: Read-only ownership verification, lease/socket inspection, source identity, and recovery gate assessment
exclusions: No live restart or process adoption
tests_and_acceptance_criteria: The manager identity and child service identities must be confirmed against current process and state records
The lease/control path remains supported and the recovery gate is not passed without explicit owner evidence
recovery_or_rollback_requirements: Explicit operator authorization and a documented maintenance window if identity is established
evidence_required: Verified ownership record, current manager/service identity tuple, and a supported handoff or recovery path

prioritized_remediation_plan.objective: Complete authenticated browser verification for the CRE and gallery contract
prerequisites: Private local unlock and auth workflow available
prioritized_remediation_plan.scope: Authenticated status/CRE/gallery read-only validation and evidence hash comparison
exclusions: No change to live auth configuration
tests_and_acceptance_criteria: Fresh authenticated responses, stale-state labeling, and scene image decode/hash verification all progress to PASS
recovery_or_rollback_requirements: If the auth window is not secure or stale state remains unresolved, revert to the prior known-good browser and do not claim a live integration
evidence_required: Authenticated response metadata, image hashes, naturalWidth/naturalHeight, and a browser console review showing no decode or stale-state failure

prioritized_remediation_plan.objective: Verify release closure and rollback integrity
prerequisites: Current source and runtime ownership are established
The exact approved release scope is known
prioritized_remediation_plan.scope: Release allowlist, bundle creation, isolated restore rehearsal, and checksum verification
tests_and_acceptance_criteria: The release archive and rollback artifact produce a clean, checksum-verified restore in an isolated environment
recovery_or_rollback_requirements: A verified rollback archive must exist and be independently checked before any deployment action
evidence_required: Bundle manifest, file allowlist, SHA-256 integrity status, and isolated restore evidence
